Product Details: The Milwaukee M18 FUEL SAWZALL Recip Saw 2 Battery Kit is the next generation of legendary performance and durability, designed for the toughest construction site applications. REDLINK PLUS electronics ensure maximum performance under stress and protection against overload, overheating and over-discharge. The included M18 REDLITHIUM XC5.0 batteries provide users with up to 2.5x runtime, offering more work per charge and more work over the lifetime of the package than competing batteries. A wear-resistant blade change, anti-corrosion blade clamp and metal-reinforced battery rails ensure longer component life and withstand the toughest workplace conditions. Lighter weight than the previous generation, the M18 FUEL SAWZALL features an adjustable shoe, integrated LED light and a hanging hook for convenient storage while on the job. This M18 FUEL SAWZALL Recipe Saw Kit includes (1) M18 FUEL SAWZALL Recipe Saw, (2) M18 REDLITHIUM XC 5.0 battery, and (1) M18/M12 charger and a case.
